**About the Job**




  





 Cohu is a global technology leader supplying test, automation, inspection and metrology products and services to the semiconductor industry. As a leading supplier of semiconductor test handlers, Cohu has a portfolio of equipment used to automate the movement of semiconductor devices, control temperature during tests and provide vision inspection; ensures quality and optimizes yield in volume production.
 



  





 We are seeking a Senior Vision Software Engineer to join our Software Engineering team in Rancho Bernardo. Under limited supervision from a designated technical lead or manager, this role designs, develops, and deploys machine vision software used for device alignment, identification, inspection, and defect detection in high throughput semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This role integrates and validates vision hardware including industrial cameras, lenses, LED illumination, and lasers, and delivers calibrated imaging systems and algorithms with factory ready diagnostics and robust production support for vision enabled tools.
 



  





 With more than 3000 employees worldwide, we offer challenging and rewarding work experiences, competitive compensation and generous employee benefits and a strong company culture. **Essential Functions/Major Responsibilities:**




  




1. Contribute to design, testing, and integration across the full project lifecycle to deliver production\-ready vision capabilities.
2. Research and develop scalable, modern computer vision for 2D/3D imaging, camera calibration, object detection, image processing, segmentation, metrology, alignment, and identification
3. Engineer vision solutions for automated test handlers and other quality inspection equipment.
4. Design, implement, and deploy full\-stack machine vision (image\-based) and machine learning solutions using C\+\+, C\#, and Python.
5. Collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing engineering teams to integrate and validate vision solutions.
6. Provide production support for the test floor and manufacturing by troubleshooting vision issues, analyzing logs/images, and implementing corrective improvements as needed.
7. Interface with customers and sales on projects as required
